upload_policy.boundary: Documented claude auth status JSON fields plus narrow Claude Desktop app-managed metadata: lastKnownAccountUuid, claude-code-sessions/local_*.json recency/session ids, and local-agent-mode-sessions/local_*.json display-safe account/org labels. Raw provider ids are hashed; token bytes, Keychain items, browser state, prompts, responses, cwd, and audit logs are never uploaded. Vertex/Bedrock novelty triggers may additionally read ~/.claude/settings.json env values (ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID, CLOUD_ML_REGION) without exposing credentials.
